errors.text_span: 最高的柱子出现在7月中旬“2022年7月15日”标签左侧附近，其最高值达到约1600000
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly locates the highest bar. It states the highest bar is to the left of the '2022年7月15日' (July 15, 2022) label. However, the tallest bar in the entire chart is located to the right of this label, around July 20th, with a value over 1,600,000 (closer to 1,700,000). The peak to the left of the July 15th label is visibly lower than the peak to its right.
